watches.name: Canton Day-Date: Slate
watches.description: The Canton Day-Date brings elevated watchmaking to the everyday. At its heart is a SW240-1 Top-Grade automatic movement, delivering the added practicality of both day and date functionality. The date is made even easier to read through a magnifier engineered beneath the crystal. The dial is precisely milled into a guilloché pattern, creating a sense of depth that shifts with the light. Built to meet the demands of daily wear, the Canton Day-Date features a hardened steel case and bracelet with a scratch-resistant coating, along with a micro-adjusting clasp for a more precise and comfortable fit. Built, tested, and regulated by skilled watchmakers in the USA, it is an everyday watch finished to a higher standard.

watches.name: Strat-o-timer 42: Americana
watches.description: The Strat-o-timer has become iconic to the Jack Mason collection since its introduction. Now, a larger 42mm version joins the line-up. For those in search of a little extra wrist presence, the new scaled dimensions are a perfect fit. The same highly praised Miyota 9075 automatic movement lives at its core. As a true travelers GMT, it grants the ability to adjust the local time via the crown without affecting the 24 hour hand or stopping the watch. Like its predecessor, the case and 7-link bracelet are both treated with a scratch-resistant coating that ensures the watch stays looking great while traveling the globe. The Strat-o-timer is assembled, and the movement regulated, in the USA.

The 40mm shaped case and 7-link bracelet remains as identifiers of the Strat-o-timer platform, but is given an alternative identity with its full Grade 2 titanium case and bracelet. With a vision of becoming a legacy brand in our home state of Texas, the Strat-o-timer is assembled, and the movement regulated, in the USA.

watches.name: Pursuit Pro Shadow
watches.description: The Pursuit Pro is seriously built for the adventurer. Inspired by the trails, the rivers, and sportsmen, the Pursuit Pro is a multipurpose tool watch at the highest level. The 120-click bi-directional bezel features a bezel guard designed to protect the ceramic insert from chipping. It also features a countdown bezel in Swiss SuperLumiNova to ensure visibility during those early morning hikes before sunrise. The dial has a matte finish and the legibility is great enhanced by solid forms of Lumicast® made with SuperLumiNova Grade X2 which boasts up to 87% performance enhancement over Grade X1. Inside, the Pursuit Pro is powered by a Swiss Made La Joux Perret G101 movement that is regulated in-house to +/-5 seconds per day, which is further protected by an anti-magnetic cage to maintain accuracy. With water resistance up to 200m, the Pursuit Pro is ready to take on any adventure.

watches.name: Halyard Sport Chronograph
watches.description: Inspired by the relaxing yet fast paced nature of sailing, the Halyard name originated from the phrase "to haul yards" and refers to the ropes used to raise a boat's sails. By combining design cues from elegant sails and classic boat design with intricate details, we created a watch that is functional yet refined. Each Halyard Sport Chronograph features an easy-to-read dial made more legible with Swiss Super-Luminova® markings and applied indices. The brushed 42mm stainless steel case is assembled and tested for water-resistance of up to 100 meters. The black unidirectional bezel gives the design a sporty aesthetic and creates a sleek, tonal design with the black dial. The black rubber strap is fitted with quick release pins and is compatible with any Jack Mason 22mm strap. The Halyard Sport Chronograph features a sapphire crystal and a Miyota OS20 movement. Assembled in the USA.
